title: Fort de la Goulette
scope: The standing protected Karaka fort in La Goulette, with the irregular limestone outer works, broad angular wings and curved open courtyard.
limitations: Wall heights, blind-side fenestration, current stone finish and individual terrace levels are approximated.
The model includes the exterior, open inner courtyard and recessed entrances. It omits adjacent landing-stage structures and interiors behind the masonry.
